jobDescription:
ABOUT GLOBALSIGN

Established in 1996, GlobalSign is the leading provider of trusted identity and security solutions enabling businesses, large enterprises, cloud service providers and IoT innovators around the world to secure online

communications, manage millions of verified digital identities and automate digital signing, authentication, and encryption. Its high- scale PKI solutions support the billions of services, devices, people, and things comprising the Internet of Everything (IoE). The company has offices in the Americas, Europe, and Asia.


JOB SUMMARY:

The AI Enablement Lead is responsible for accelerating the adoption and valorisation of artificial intelligence (AI) across GlobalSign. Working within the IT Department and reporting to the Chief Information and Security Officer, this role owns AI governance and policy, evaluates and rationalizes the AI tool portfolio, prepares the organization's knowledge and data for AI use, leads AI-driven business process transformation, measures the value delivered, and develops AI capability across the workforce. The AI Enablement Lead is the primary internal catalyst for AI-driven transformation, from strategy and tooling through to hands-on delivery support .


Role & responsibilities

1. Drive AI Governance and Policy Optimization

  • Own and continuously optimize GlobalSign's AI usage policy, acceptable-use standards, and approval workflows, keeping them practical enough to encourage adoption while protecting the company's position as a publicly trusted certificate authority.
  • Define and govern the AI operating model: platform selection, data usage, security-by-design, model lifecycle management, and integration with existing IT architecture.
  • Set human-in-the-loop, review, and disclosure requirements for AI outputs used in regulated, audited, or customer-facing processes, and refresh policy as tool capabilities change.

2. Evaluate Emerging AI Technologies and Optimize the Tool Portfolio

  • Scan the market for emerging AI models, agents, copilots, and platforms, and run structured evaluations against capability, total cost, security posture, data residency, and integration fit.
  • Rationalize the tool portfolio by consolidating overlapping tools and retiring those underused or superseded and support procurement and legal review of AI vendors.
  • Maintain reusable frameworks and reference architectures so departments build on a consistent foundation and advise leadership on build-versus-buy and investment priorities.

3. Establish AI-Ready Knowledge and Data Management Practices

  • Define how enterprise knowledge is structured, labelled, owned, and maintained so that it can be reliably retrieved and used by AI systems.
  • Lead the design of retrieval-augmented generation foundations: source-of-truth repositories, indexing strategy, access controls, and rules for content freshness and ownership.
  • Set data classification and handling rules governing which data may reach which AI systems and improve data quality in the systems feeding AI use cases.

4. Manage AI Adoption Metrics and Subscription Inventory

  • Maintain a complete inventory of AI tools, agents, models, and subscriptions, including business owner, cost, contract terms, renewal dates, and governance status.
  • Track license utilization and adoption by department and users, identifying under-used seats, unmet demand, and unsanctioned shadow AI.
  • Drive cost optimization through rightsizing, consolidation, and timely renewal or cancellation decisions.

5. Lead AI-Driven Business Process Transformation

  • Map existing processes with department leads, identify automation and augmentation opportunities, and prioritize them by value, feasibility, and risk.
  • Redesign workflows around AI capabilities rather than layering tools onto unchanged processes, translating business problems into scoped use cases with named owners.
  • Move teams from proof-of-concept to production deployment, providing hands-on delivery support and coordinating across departments to avoid duplication.

6. Measure, Track, and Report Business Impact

  • Define AI value KPIs covering adoption, efficiency gains, cost, quality, risk reduction, and customer impact, and establish baselines before deployment.
  • Build and maintain a central AI value dashboard showing active initiatives, their status, and their measured outcomes.
  • Report to leadership and the Board on realized versus projected value, and recommend whether initiatives are scaled, sustained, or stopped.

REQUIRED SKILLS:

  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience
  • Demonstrable experience in AI, data, technology consulting, or IT strategy role, with hands-on delivery of AI or automation projects at organizational level.
  • Strong understanding of modern AI concepts including large language models, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, and copilot architectures.
  • Proven ability to define, track, and communicate value metrics and KPIs related to technology adoption and business impact.
  • Experience establishing knowledge management, documentation, or data governance standards, and managing a software or SaaS portfolio including licenses, cost, and renewals .

title: Agentic AI Developer
jobDescription:
We're looking for an Agentic AI Developer who lives at the intersection of applied LLM engineering and production software. You'll design and ship the AI agents and orchestration flows at the core of Synthetix reasoning loops, tool use, multi-agent coordination, memory, and the governance rails that keep them trustworthy.

You're comfortable across the stack, but your center of gravity is agent creation: turning a capability into a reliable, observable, evaluable agent. This is a hands-on builder role — you'll prototype fast, harden what works, and own agents from design through production.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and ship AI agents using modern agent frameworks — OpenAI Agents SDK, Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK), Microsoft Agent Framework / AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalents — picking the right tool for each problem.
  • Architect multi-agent orchestration and stateful workflows with LangGraph, LangChain, and similar frameworks: planning, routing, hand-offs, retries, and durable long-running execution.
  • Implement robust tool / function calling, structured outputs, and external-system integration, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and connectors.
  • Build the retrieval and memory layers — RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector search, and short- and long-term agent memory.
  • Bake in governance from day one: guardrails, policy enforcement, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, audit trails, and safe-failure behavior — the governed in governed orchestration.
  • Stand up evaluation and observability — agent evals, LLM-as-judge, tracing, and telemetry (e.g., LangSmith, Langfuse, OpenTelemetry) — to measure and continuously improve agent reliability.
  • Integrate agents into full-stack applications across APIs, services, and front-end surfaces, collaborating closely with platform, product, and design.
  • Optimize for cost, latency, and quality across model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic / Claude, Google / Gemini, and open-weight models).

What You'll Bring

  • 3+ years building and shipping production software, with meaningful recent hands-on experience building AI agents or LLM-powered applications.
  • Strong Python (the working language of agent development) and solid TypeScript / JavaScript for full-stack integration.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one agent framework / SDK (OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar) and one orchestration framework (LangChain / LangGraph or equivalent).
  • A solid grasp of LLM building blocks: prompting, function / tool calling, structured outputs, context-window management, RAG, and embeddings / vector databases.
  • Full-stack fluency: REST / async APIs (FastAPI, NestJS, or similar), relational databases (PostgreSQL), and enough front-end (React) to build and integrate end-to-end.
  • Familiarity with cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), containers (Docker), and CI/CD.
  • A product mindset, strong debugging instincts, and the judgment to make non-deterministic systems behave reliably.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with MCP, Temporal or other durable-execution engines, and event-driven architectures.
  • Exposure to enterprise / regulated environments — SSO, RBAC, data governance, and compliance.
  • Fine-tuning, prompt-optimization, or model-routing experience.
  • Open-source contributions in the agent / LLM ecosystem.

About the role


Role Summary: Software Engineer, Internal AI Products


A Software Engineer who builds the tools this company runs on. You build agent loops, and the loops build the solutions. You work towards a Company Brain that anyone here can ask.35 years’ experience • Reports to the CFO • 


THE KEY SKILL:

You build the agent loops that build the solutions. You will not write every automation by hand. You build the loops that
write them. Ship a prototype every week. You ship something every day.

You’ll be building a Company Brain with access control. One system that holds what the company knows about finance,delivery and people. Anyone can ask it a question. Each person sees only what they are cleared to see.

One hard filter. If you cannot write and debug production code, and have not done it before, please do not apply.


CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Work the backlog: You pick items off a live, ranked backlog. You learn each function by building inside it. There is no discovery phase. What you learn goes back into the backlog and changes what comes next.
  • Build the product: You design, build and ship tools that people use every day. Reconciliation, MIS, the deal desk,quote to cash, or whatever the real bottleneck turns out to be. You choose the tools and frameworks.
  • Wire the data: Connect the systems each team already uses, so that the same number means the same thing everywhere.
  • Make it visible: You build live dashboards and alerts that leaders read on their own, instead of asking someone for a report.
  • Keep it running: You own uptime and accuracy for everything you build. Anything that touches money or people needs a person in the loop.

THE STACK:


  • Build with: Python and TypeScript. You write production code. Frontier model APIs from Anthropic, OpenAI or Google, with tool calling and structured output. At least one agent framework. MCP to connect agents to internal systems.Postgres and pgvector, or something similar, for retrieval. You deploy on GCP, and you debug your own work.
  • Work in agents daily: Claude Code, Cursor or something like them, as the way you write code every day. You should have a clear view on how to run the loop, and on when a person has to step in.
  • Connect to: The systems we already run on for accounting, CRM, hiring and IT support, along with Google Workspace.Most of the work is getting them to agree with each other.
  • Check what you ship: Anything that produces a number needs a way to catch it going quietly wrong. Test sets, regression checks, and alerts on the output as well as on the job.

WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE:

  • Something you built is running by week two, and someone is using it.
    • By day 90, time spent on reconciliation or reporting is down by a number you can defend to the CFO.
    • Every tool you ship has a named owner who is still using it 60 days later. That is the measure that counts.
    • Leaders stop asking for numbers, because they can already see them.
    • By the end of your first year, a first version of the Company Brain answers real questions about Finance, and each
    person who asks sees only what they are cleared to see.

WHO THIS IS FOR:

  • You have built products: 3 to 5 years at a software product company, on a product with real users at scale. That means 100k+ monthly active users, or heavy daily use by a large enterprise customer base. You have owned code in production, in front of real users, long after it shipped.
    • You ship alone: You are comfortable as the only engineer in the room, and the only person on call for what you built.
    • You work out new ground fast: A domain you do not know is interesting to you. You start without waiting for a spec or an expert.
    • You are fluent with agents: One person cannot cover a whole company by hand. You use agent loops heavily and youare good at it.
    • You write and speak clearly: Half this job is pulling a process out of a finance or delivery lead and giving it back to them correctly. You work remotely, so this matters a great deal.

HOW WE WILL ASSESS:
• A design problem: Live. We give you a function of the B2B company, and you design the system for it. We watch how you break down a domain you do not know, how you size it, and what you leave out on purpose.
• A build exercise: Live and screen-shared, on your own setup, with your own agents. You build the way you normally build. We watch how you run the loop, when you step in, and what you decide to skip.
• Your work and your questions: We talk about what you have shipped before. You ask us whatever you want.

Communication is not a separate round. All three sessions are live, and how clearly you explain your thinking is part of how we judge you.


WHERE IT LEADS
You report to the CEO and CFO from your first day. Your charter covers the whole company. Nothing sits between you and production. Very few engineering jobs offer all three at once, and that is why this one exists.
In 18 months you will know how this company really runs: the data, the money, and the gaps between teams. The rolethen changes shape to fit whatever the biggest open problem is by then.

jobDescription:
Job Title : Senior Product Manager

Location : Bangalore; (Full Time, Onsite)

About Locus

Battle-tested in 350+ deployments across 30+ countries, Locus is an agentic Transportation Management System for all-mile, all-channel, trusted by enterprises like Unilever, Nestl , and Siam Makro.

The platform unifies orders, capacity, and carrier networks into one living plan, aligning planning, execution, and settlement so promises become proof. AI co-pilots with guardrails surface risk early and recommend the next best move to protect SLAs and reduce empty miles.

In 2025, Locus joined the Ingka Group (IKEA Retail) family, marking a major milestone in our journey. Backed by the scale and strength of IKEA, we continue to operate independently while accelerating our mission to make global supply chains faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

Our Journey and Impact

Since 2015, Locus has been on a mission to make logistics decision-making intelligent, sustainable, and real-world ready. Our platform has powered billions of deliveries across 30 + countries for global enterprises, driving measurable impact in cost savings, carbon reduction, and SLA performance. With the strength of the IKEA ecosystem behind us, we re scaling that impact even further.

Our Global Footprint

Headquartered in Bangalore, with teams across the U.S., U.K., UAE, and Southeast Asia, Locus brings together 170 + engineers, designers, and problem-solvers united by a single goal: to reinvent how the world moves goods.

Traits We Value

We look for people who are:

  • Global in mindset : curious about diverse markets and ideas.

  • Unrelenting in drive : energized by complex challenges.

  • Intelligent in approach : analytical, creative, and thoughtful.

  • Dynamic in execution : adaptive and decisive in fast-moving contexts.

  • Exact in craft : detail-oriented and committed to excellence.

About the role

Locus is rebuilding last-mile delivery as a multi-tenant SaaS platform. The DiSCO Mobile App is the driver-facing surface - used by drivers, 2-person crews, and hub-ops staff across enterprise tenants (IKEA, Giant Tiger, and the long tail of Locus customers).

The Senior PM will own one or more product modules end-to-end - Hub Depot Operations, Execution at Customer Stop, Returns Reverse Logistics, Multi-Trip Shifts, or Workforce Auth - from scoping with domain PMs, through workflow design with UX, to release readiness with the engineering pod and customer-onboarding teams.

The role partners with the Principal PM on overall app vision and runs its modules independently.


What youll do

  • Own a slice of the mobile app: scope it, write the spec, drive design partnership, shepherd it through engineering, land it in tenant rollouts.

  • Author mobile workflow specs (Delivery / Pickup / Hub Depot / Returns) and the matching epic + story tickets in Jira.

  • Coordinate with domain PMs (Execution, Hub Ops, Workforce, Order Management) to translate entity specs and design decisions into driver-facing scenarios.

  • Partner with UX on gap closure and with the mobile engineering pod on sequencing and delivery.

  • Own one or more enterprise tenant rollouts - translating customer requirements into product changes vs. tenant config, and holding the line on what is product-grade vs. one-off.

  • Uphold platform defaults: client-agnostic architecture, point-of-use permissions, plain-language UX, no over-engineered enterprise theatre.

What were looking for

  • 6+ years in product management, including 3+ years on enterprise SaaS or platform products. Mobile app PM experience is a strong plus.

  • Shipped in domain-heavy, multi-team environments - comfortable reading entity specs, sequence diagrams, and engineering RFCs, not just user stories.

  • Spec author. Can write a 3,000-word workflow doc that engineering, design, and customer success can all build from.

  • Strong opinions about driver / operator UX - has shipped for low-context, high-pressure mobile users (delivery, field service, frontline ops, warehousing).

  • Jira-as-source-of-truth discipline: every scope decision is a ticket, every blocker is a link, every spec gap is a child story.

  • Bias toward plain language, concrete examples, and decision-by-tradeoff over decision-by-framework.

Nice to have

  • Logistics / last-mile / supply-chain domain background.

  • Multi-tenant SaaS scoping experience (whats product vs. whats tenant config).

  • Comfort with domain-driven teams (DDD, event sourcing, entity-first specs


What We Offer

Join Locus and become part of a visionary team that is redefining logistics through innovation and smart distribution. We provide competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a collaborative environment where your expertise will drive both your growth and that of the organization.

Locus is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Technical Solutions Lead, Nature-Based Carbon

Location: Gurgaon, India

Tags: Nature Based Solutions Regenerative Agriculture Agroforestry Arr Afforestation Soil Carbon Agronomy Mrv Remote Sensing Carbon Methodology Due Diligence Technical Writing Additionality Permanence Smallholder Farming Contract Farming Agri Business Sustainable Sourcing Climate Tech Voluntary Carbon Market

About Varaha

Varaha is the largest carbon removal developer in Asia, working with more than 200,000 smallholder farmers. Trusted by brands like Google and Microsoft, we combine an exceptional team with deeply impactful work. Through regenerative agriculture, afforestation, and biochar, our projects remove carbon while simultaneously restoring soils, protecting biodiversity, and improving livelihoods far beyond our project boundaries. We are a profitable, rapidly growing company backed by premier global private equity and top-tier venture capital. Our roots are in India, and our impact is global.

The Opportunity

Varaha runs the largest smallholder soil carbon project in the world and has closed the largest regenerative agriculture deals in the market. Behind that sits a measurement stack built on multiple bio-geo-chemical models, remote sensing, and machine learning, calibrated against physical soil samples from the field by a world-class science team. Buyers, auditors, and funders all want the same thing from it: a clear, sourced account of what we measured and why it holds.

You are the commercial teams technical authority on regenerative agriculture and afforestation, and the person who turns several hundred thousand hectares of fieldwork into documents a Chief Sustainability Officer can act on. Regenerative agriculture comes first. Afforestation and reforestation follow.

We are deliberately open on background. Agronomists from agri-conglomerates, people who have run contract farming or sustainable sourcing programmes at scale, agri-input and agri-tech technical leads, remote sensing specialists, and programme leads who have delivered smallholder work across large geographies all fit. What matters is that you have stood in a field, know what the data from it can and cannot support, and write clearly.

Reporting To: CCO

Key Responsibilities

  • Answer buyer and auditor diligence. Sort what you can answer now from what needs expert input, then produce the response with sources, assumptions, and the limits of the claim stated.

  • Sit in on sales calls. You explain the measurement, the project, and the impact directly to the client. The project team stays on the projects.

  • Run our side of ratings and verification. Prepare submissions, handle analyst and auditor questions, and push back with evidence where a finding is wrong.

  • Build the answer library so the same question is never answered from scratch twice and our language stays consistent across proposals, contracts, and project documents.

  • Create what is missing. Method summaries, appendices, diagrams, data summaries, and operating procedures, wherever a gap is holding up a deal.

  • Turn data into claims. Read agronomy datasets and remote sensing outputs and convert them into short statements we can defend in front of a buyer.

  • Cover the impact side. Farmer and community outcomes weigh as heavily with buyers as the carbon itself. You build the evidence base on incomes, livelihoods, and co-benefits across 200,000+ smallholders, work with what the field data supports when it is limited, and state where it is thin.

  • Guide the commercial team on presenting technical content accurately, and train them to handle the straightforward questions themselves.

Qualifications

  • 4-10 years working on agriculture, agroforestry, or land use, ideally involving smallholder farmers in Asia or Africa.

  • Technical writing that has survived outside scrutiny. Project documents, monitoring reports, diligence responses, or funding proposals. Please send samples.

  • A working grasp of the fundamentals that decide whether a carbon project is credible: baselines, additionality, permanence, leakage, and buffer pools. If you know these from an adjacent field, say so and we will look at it.

  • Comfort with soil carbon or biomass measurement, sampling design, and the monitoring that sits around it.

  • Ability to work with agronomy data and remote sensing outputs directly.

  • Skilled at using AI tools to digest dense material and produce strong first drafts fast.

  • Written English at a standard that holds in front of international buyers.

  • Commercial judgement. Benefits, costs, and risks presented without inflation.

  • Structured habits: clean intake, targeted questions to experts, careful citation, and documents you can find again.

Preferred

  • Experience with any carbon standard, including direct auditor interaction. Not required.

  • Grant or concessional funding proposals with results you can point to.

  • Writing operating procedures for field protocols and quality control.

  • Confident enough on a call to lead a session with a US or European buyer alone.

Why This Role Matters

Nature-based carbon has a credibility problem across the industry, and much of it comes down to how the work is explained. Varahas measurement is among the strongest in the sector. Making that legible to buyers and funders moves capital toward 200,000 smallholder land stewards who are already doing the work.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity through ESOPs.

  • The first seat in this function. You define how it works.

  • Direct exposure to the largest corporate carbon buyers in the world.

  • Support for learning and professional development.

  • A culture of undogmatic, unbureaucratic creativity and collaboration.

Job Title: AI Engineer

Company: Outscale Partners

Location: Hybrid | Experience: 7 8 Years | Experience in AI: 4 5 Years | Openings: 2



About Outscale Partners

Outscale Partners (formerly AMH Services) is a Gurgaon, India-based global capability center (GCC) and strategic business solutions partner for the Argenbright Group, founded in 2022. It offers AI-enabled services in HR, finance, IT, legal, and customer support, focusing on rapid, scalable growth for enterprises



Role Summary

Reporting to the Senior AI Consultant, the AI Engineer will design, build, deploy, and operate AI systems across Unifi Service s enterprise platforms.

The role spans the entire AI lifecycle use-case identification, model and system design, production deployment, monitoring, optimization, and continuous improvement.



Core Responsibilities

Build and integrate AI-driven capabilities into enterprise applications and workflows using leading LLM platforms.

Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures to enable AI systems to securely leverage internal knowledge and data sources.

Develop and orchestrate AI agents capable of executing multi-step, decision-based business processes.

Own production AI systems end-to-end, including deployment, versioning, monitoring, scaling, and cost optimization.

Define, implement, and maintain evaluation metrics for AI quality, reliability, latency, and cost efficiency.

Collaborate closely with Leadership, Product and Engineering teams to identify, prioritize, and deliver high-impact AI solutions.

Ensure AI solutions follow enterprise standards for security, data privacy, reliability, and maintainability.



Must-Have (Non-Negotiable) Skills Experience

7 to 8 years of overall software engineering experience, with 3 to 4 years of hands-on work on production AI / LLM systems.

Strong proficiency in Python, with experience writing production-quality, testable, and maintainable code.

Proven experience designing and implementing RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, and response generation.

Hands-on experience with vector databases (e.g., Qdrant, FAISS, ChromaDb, or similar).

Practical experience using LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Autogen, Haystack, or Semantic Kernel.

Prior experience building AI solutions in SaaS or enterprise-scale software environments.

Experience integrating with major LLM providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or Google Gemini.

Solid understanding of prompt engineering, context engineering (context window management), and output control techniques.

Experience deploying AI systems to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) using Docker and Kubernetes.

Working knowledge of LLMOps MLOps practices, including model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and rollback strategies.

Experience in implementing guardrails in AI Solutions along with Observability.



Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications

Exposure to multimodal AI systems, model fine-tuning, or reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF).

Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Understanding of AI cost optimization, latency tuning, and performance benchmarking in production.

Experience with domains such as eCommerce, Retail, HR, Finance, Legal, Compliance, etc



Language Documentation Expectations

All production AI code must be clearly documented, version-controlled, and supported by appropriate tests.

AI pipelines, prompts, and agent workflows must include design documentation and usage guidelines.

Each production AI system must have defined ownership, monitoring dashboards, and operational runbooks.

Clear documentation of model limitations, assumptions, and fallback behaviours is mandatory.




What We Offer

High-visibility role with direct access to senior leadership and decision-makers.

Opportunity to design and own enterprise-scale AI systems with real business impact.

Hybrid work arrangement, balancing flexibility with collaboration.

title: Senior Technical Consultant - Shift Lead
jobDescription:
Job Summary

As a Senior Technical Consultant (Shift Lead) in the Shared Data/ODSP Factory, you will lead on shift technical delivery for tenant to tenant migrations of collaboration content across Microsoft 365, typically SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business and associated Teams/M365 Group content structures. You will run a controlled, metrics driven migration factory, ensuring runbooks are executed consistently, migrations are scheduled and monitored, permissions/metadata fidelity is validated and defects are remediated efficiently. You will be accountable for shift throughput, quality gates, evidence capture and operational reporting while coordinating escalations and ensuring seamless handovers across the 24x7 model.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical execution of SharePoint/OneDrive/ODSP migration waves during your shift, ensuring runbook adherence and predictable throughput.
  • Own shift triage for failures (throttling, permissions mapping issues, blocked files, metadata/versioning exceptions, large list/library constraints, URL/path constraints).
  • Validate readiness: source/target access, migration accounts/consents, pre checks, quota constraints and cutover schedule alignment.
  • Configure, schedule and monitor migration jobs using the approved toolset (native and/or third party), proactively identifying risks before they become wave blockers.
  • Enforce quality gates: sampling/validation outcomes, permission parity checks, metadata fidelity and user experience verification.
  • Maintain operational control of the shift backlog and prioritise tasks based on cutover plans, dependencies and SLA.
  • Produce and manage evidence packs per wave: migration reports, exception logs, remediation records, sign off artefacts and audit trail completeness.
  • Coordinate handovers with clear exceptions, blockers and next actions; ensure continuity of long running migration jobs across shifts.
  • Drive continuous improvement: update runbooks, known error catalogues and operational dashboards; reduce recurring failures and rework.
  • Manage escalations (vendor support, platform support pathways, programme technical leadership) with complete diagnostic context and clear asks.

Requirements

Must Have

  • Delivered at least one production tenant to tenant migration of SharePoint Online and/or OneDrive (ODSP) content as a senior SME/lead.
  • Deep expertise in SharePoint Online/OneDrive architecture concepts relevant to migration: site structures, permissions models, sharing/links, metadata/versioning, information architecture constraints.
  • Hands on experience with migration tooling in this space (e.g., ShareGate and/or Quest ODM or equivalent) and the ability to run migrations at scale.
  • Proven ability to run migration operations in a factory model: scheduling, monitoring, exception handling and quality gates at high volume.
  • Strong understanding of security/compliance impacts in migrated content (sensitivity labels/retention behaviours where applicable; access governance, least privilege).
  • Strong runbook discipline and evidence capture practice; comfortable being held to audit standards for every wave.

Good to Have

  • Experience migrating Teams associated content dependencies (files in SharePoint, OneDrive artefacts linked to user data used by collaboration features) and coordinating sequencing.
  • Familiarity with multi geo considerations and URL/domain nuances that can impact migration execution.
  • Microsoft certifications relevant to Microsoft 365 administration (e.g., MS 102) or SharePoint specialism, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience using PowerShell/Graph for reporting, bulk checks, or automation around migration readiness and validation.
  • Knowledge of data governance, information architecture and content lifecycle management in Microsoft 365.

Interpersonal & Consulting Skills

  • Keeps shift teams focused on plan and standards; prevents uncontrolled variation in execution.
  • Communicates clearly with upstream/downstream disciplines (Identity, Teams, Adoption, Security) to manage dependencies and unblock progress.
  • Escalates early and responsibly with evidence; avoids late surprises .
  • Coaches engineers to solve problems systematically (root cause, pattern recognition, runbook refinement).
  • Strong stakeholder communication habits suitable for a major programme: concise, factual, action oriented updates.
  • Builds trust through calm leadership during cutovers and operational incidents.

Typical Deliverables / KPIs

  • Throughput: sites/OneDrives migrated per shift; data volume migrated vs plan.
  • Defect rate: percentage of migrations requiring re run; recurring exception types reduced over time.
  • MTTR: resolution time for migration blockers and priority incidents.
  • Evidence capture: percentage of waves with complete exportable reports and sign off records.
  • SLA: scheduled cutovers achieved on time with managed risk and exceptions logged.

Shift / Working Pattern Notes

  • This role operates within a three shift 24x7 Factory model. The specific rota will be confirmed, but shift handovers are mandatory and performance is measured on shift outcomes. Peak cutover windows may require schedule flexibility.

title: Senior UCIe Verification Engineer
jobDescription:
Introduction

We are looking for a Senior UCIe Verification Engineer with strong experience in SystemVerilog/UVM-based verification of high-speed interconnects and SoC subsystems. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in verifying UCIe (Universal Chiplet Interconnect Express) IP and should have contributed to at least 1-2 successful SoC tape-outs. The role involves developing reusable verification environments, protocol compliance verification, subsystem/SoC integration, and driving verification closure.


About Edgecortix

At Edgecortix we are a deep-tech startup revolutionizing edge computing with artificial intelligence and novel high efficiency silicon on chip design. Originating from multiple years of research, our unique AI hardware & software co-design principle and the Dynamic Neural Accelerator AI processor IP are geared towards positively disrupting the rapidly growing artificial intelligence edge hardware space and bring the power of AI and machine learning to all kinds of devices. Our operations are headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, with offices in Singapore, Virginia, California in the US. In addition, we are starting a new Design Center in India, located in Hyderabad.

The Team

As an engineering driven company we are working to define and solve the hardest problems in AI including computer vision, speech, and natural language, geared towards real-time capabilities on small to medium form factor devices. We originated out of multiple years of research, as such at our core we value learning, intellectual curiosity, and self-starters. We have the ambitious goal of enabling cloud-level performance with significantly better energy-efficiency for AI inference at the edge.

Your Role and Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute comprehensive verification plans for UCIe IP, subsystems, and SoC integration.
  • Build reusable SystemVerilog/UVM verification environments from scratch.
  • Develop constrained-random and directed test scenarios to verify UCIe functionality and protocol compliance.
  • Verify UCIe protocol features, including:
    Link initialization and training
    Sideband communication
    Adapter layer
    Protocol layer
    Data transfer and flow control
    Link power management
    Error detection and recovery
    Reset and initialization sequences
  • Verify interoperability between UCIe and upper-layer protocols such as PCIe, CXL, or streaming interfaces.
  • Develop UVM agents, scoreboards, monitors, protocol checkers, and functional coverage models.
  • Write and debug SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) for protocol compliance and interface checks.
  • Perform coverage analysis and drive functional and code coverage closure.
  • Debug RTL, protocol, and testbench issues using simulation and waveform analysis.
  • Support gate-level simulations, regression execution, and silicon bring-up activities.
  • Collaborate closely with architecture, RTL, DFT, firmware, physical design, and validation teams throughout the product development cycle.



Desired Qualifications:

  • 6-12 years of experience in functional verification using SystemVerilog and UVM.
  • Strong experience in developing complete UVM verification environments from scratch.
  • Good understanding of UCIe architecture and protocol.
  • Experience verifying high-speed serial interfaces or chiplet interconnects.
  • Strong understanding of:
    AXI4
    High-speed protocol verification
    Clock domain crossings (CDC)
    Reset domain crossings (RDC)
    Protocol compliance verification
  • Experience with constrained-random, assertion-based, and coverage-driven verification methodologies.
  • Strong experience writing SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA).
  • Experience with gate-level simulation and timing-aware verification.
  • Excellent RTL and protocol debugging skills.
  • Experience in verifying die-to-die interfaces or chiplet-based architectures.
  • Experience with subsystem and SoC-level verification.
  • Experience with emulator-based verification platforms.
  • Exposure to Formal Verification techniques.
  • Familiarity with Continuous Integration (CI/CD) tools such as Jenkins or GitLab CI.
  • Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Perl, or Tcl.
  • Experience with version control systems such as Git.
  • SoC Experience
    Hands-on experience in 1-2 successful SoC tape-outs.
    Experience integrating UCIe subsystems into complex SoCs.
    Exposure to boot flows, clock/reset architecture, power management, and chiplet integration.
    Experience collaborating with firmware and post-silicon validation teams during bring-up and debug.

You guide Scale squads and the Factory through device migration sequencing, Intune re enrolment impacts, Autopilot/join state considerations and remediation patterns. This role is critical to avoiding mass disruption: endpoint readiness issues can block user productivity at wave cutovers, so your job is to standardise solutions, reduce repeat failures and provide rapid escalation leadership during cutover windows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide endpoint readiness guidance and risk assessments for migration waves.
  • Act as escalation authority for complex device migration failures and root cause analysis.
  • Define and maintain runbooks for common remediation scenarios (enrolment failures, compliance issues, profile/application targeting problems).
  • Coordinate dependencies with Identity and Security teams (device trust and access controls).
  • Support cutover events with rapid triage and stabilisation leadership.
  • Maintain known issues and fixes catalogue; reduce recurring defects through standard patterns.
  • Provide validation criteria and evidence standards for endpoint readiness and post migration acceptance.
  • Support the Factory discipline leads by improving troubleshooting playbooks and telemetry standards.
  • Provide reporting inputs on failure categories, remediation throughput and readiness health metrics.
  • Align to one region and adjust working patterns to support regional cutovers.

Who You Are

Must Have

  • Delivered tenant to tenant endpoint migration work in production (Intune/Windows specialism mandatory).
  • Deep Intune operational expertise and troubleshooting competence.
  • Practical understanding of device join state and provisioning concepts relevant to tenant transitions.
  • Proven ability to create runbooks, validation steps and known fix playbooks for repeatable execution.
  • Willingness to align working hours to regional cutovers (early/late calls) and support extended hours when required.
  • Strong documentation discipline and evidence first practices.
  • Ability to coach engineers and improve delivery maturity at pace.

Good to Have

  • Experience with workstation/profile migration tooling (e.g., PowerSyncPro or equivalent) and hands on understanding of real world constraints.
  • Microsoft certification alignment relevant to endpoint management (or equivalent experience).
  • PowerShell scripting for diagnostics, readiness reporting and bulk remediation.
  • Experience with large, globally distributed device estates and remote workforce constraints.

Interpersonal & Consulting Skills

  • Calm escalation leadership in user impacting cutover events.
  • Clear communicator: logs, evidence and precise guidance rather than guesswork.
  • Strong coaching and collaboration behaviours across shifts and teams.
  • Risk and dependency management mindset; prevents avoidable disruption.
  • High integrity around access/security and change discipline.
  • Strong written communication: tickets, handovers, playbooks.

Typical Deliverables / KPIs

  • Lower endpoint migration failure rate and improved first time success.
  • MTTR for endpoint migration blockers during cutovers.
  • Repeat issue reduction via improved runbooks and known fix catalogues.
  • Evidence completion rate for endpoint acceptance checks.
  • Readiness pass rate for endpoint components at wave entry.

Shift / Working Pattern Notes

Scale teams operate as a cohesive unit within a follow the sun project delivery model. Each scale team works an 8 hour shift, scheduled across a 24 hour global working day. Structured handovers between scale teams are mandatory and cutover periods may require rota flexibility.

title: Senior Technical Consultant - Shift Lead (Devices Tenant Migration)
jobDescription:
Job Summary

As a Senior Technical Consultant (Shift Lead) within the Devices Factory, you will serve as the on shift technical authority for high volume device migrations between Microsoft 365 tenants for a global multi entity enterprise. You will lead execution across a 24x7 factory model, coordinating repeatable, runbook driven waves of Windows 10/11 device transition, Intune/Endpoint Manager re enrolment patterns and Autopilot/Entra join-state activities. You will be accountable for shift readiness (tooling, access, queues), quality gates, evidence capture and rapid issue resolution so that device migrations are delivered safely, predictably and at programme scale. This is a hands on leadership role: you will still troubleshoot complex device migration failures, but your primary success measure is consistent throughput with low rework and disciplined shift operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical delivery of device migration waves during your shift, ensuring operational control, adherence to runbooks and predictable throughput.
  • Own shift level triage for device migration failures (Autopilot registration, enrolment, compliance, conditional access, certificate/device identity issues) and coordinate rapid remediation.
  • Validate pre req readiness (device inventory, hardware hash readiness, targeting, Autopilot profile assignment, migration scheduling) and enforce go/no go criteria.
  • Oversee execution of tenant transition steps for Autopilot where applicable (collection of hashes, deregistration/deletion sequencing, re registration timing, end user reset/re provision coordination).
  • Manage the shift backlog in the agreed ticketing system; prioritise work items by risk, SLA and cutover schedule.
  • Drive strong evidence capture: logs, screenshots, reports, change records and acceptance artefacts aligned to audit and client governance needs.
  • Coordinate shift handover packs (work completed, exceptions, blockers, next actions, risk list) and ensure continuity across the three shift model.
  • Partner with the Devices Solution Architect / discipline lead to update runbooks, troubleshooting guides and standard operating procedures based on real shift learnings.
  • Engage vendor/tool support channels as required (e.g., Autopilot/Intune escalation paths, migration tooling vendors where used), ensuring timely escalations with complete evidence.
  • Lead post migration validation checks and hypercare support for device cohorts; reduce repeat incidents through root cause removal and runbook improvements.

Must Have (or Equivalent Experience)

  • Delivered at least one production tenant to tenant device migration as a technical lead/SME, specifically covering Windows device transition and endpoint management between tenants.
  • Strong hands on expertise with Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Manager, Windows 10/11 provisioning, device compliance policies, configuration profiles and troubleshooting enrolment failures.
  • Hands on experience with Windows Autopilot (device registration concepts, profile assignment, re provisioning) and practical migration sequencing across tenants.
  • Competence in Microsoft Entra ID device identity/join states (Entra joined / hybrid joined / registered concepts) and how these affect access, compliance and conditional access behaviour.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in a runbook first factory model: strict execution steps, peer checking/quality gates and disciplined closure criteria.
  • Proven experience working shift-based delivery with mandatory handovers, queue management and accountability for shift outcomes in a 24x7 environment.
  • Strong PowerShell and automation capability for device readiness and operational scripting (inventory validation, hash collection, reporting, bulk actions), with safe change practices.
  • Strong documentation discipline: ability to produce and maintain clear SOPs, troubleshooting playbooks and evidence packs per migration wave.

Good to Have

  • Experience using profile preservation / workstation migration tooling (e.g., PowerSyncPro or equivalent) to reduce user disruption and post cutover issues.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft security controls impacting devices (Conditional Access trust settings, compliant/hybrid joined trust, device-based access patterns).
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications (examples: MD 102, MS 102, SC 300 or equivalent).
  • Experience supporting global migrations with remote user populations and proactive comms/coordination playbooks.
  • ITIL practice awareness (incident/problem/change flow) or equivalent operational governance background.

Interpersonal & Consulting Skills

  • Leads with calm operational control under pressure; sets the tone for disciplined factory execution and avoids heroics that compromise repeatability.
  • Communicates clearly in shift handovers: concise status, crisp risk articulation, unambiguous next actions.
  • Coaches engineers in-flight (without slowing throughput), raising capability by reinforcing patterns, not ad hoc fixes.
  • Confident challenging readiness gaps ( not ready to migrate ) using evidence and agreed criteria.
  • Builds trust quickly with cross functional teams (Identity, Security, Shared Data, Service Desk/hypercare) to remove blockers.
  • Demonstrates ownership: takes problems to closure, documents learning and drives runbook improvements.
  • Works effectively across cultures and time zones; assumes positive intent and maintains high standards.
  • Treats the client environment with professional discipline: secure handling of access, data and evidence artefacts.

Typical Deliverables / KPIs

  • Throughput: devices migrated per shift / per wave vs plan.
  • Quality: first time success rate and defect/rework rate (failed enrolments, repeat tickets).
  • MTTR: mean time to restore/resolve for migration blocking device issues.
  • Evidence capture completeness: percentage of migrations with full log/audit package attached.
  • SLA adherence: on time completion of scheduled waves and timely escalation of blockers.

Shift / Working Pattern Notes

This role operates within a three shift 24x7 Factory model. The specific rota will be confirmed, but shift handovers are mandatory and performance is measured on shift outcomes. Peak cutover windows may require schedule flexibility.

Position details

We are seeking an experienced Senior Dynatrace Observability Engineer / Administrator to lead the implementation, administration, and continuous enhancement of the Dynatrace SaaS observability platform. The successful candidate will possess strong expertise in end-to-end monitoring, event management, ServiceNow integration, dashboard engineering, and automation.

This role will work closely with Infrastructure, Application, Network, Security, Cloud, and Service Management teams to deliver a unified observability framework, improve operational visibility, accelerate incident resolution, and drive proactive monitoring across enterprise services.

Key Responsibilities

Dynatrace Platform Administration & Architecture

  • Administer and manage the Dynatrace SaaS platform, including OneAgent, ActiveGate, extensions, integrations, and tenant configurations.

  • Design and maintain scalable observability architecture supporting infrastructure, applications, databases, middleware, network, and cloud environments.

  • Configure monitoring policies, management zones, tagging strategies, alerting profiles, and role-based access controls.

  • Lead platform upgrades, configuration optimization, and adoption of new Dynatrace capabilities.

Monitoring & Observability Engineering

  • Develop and implement enterprise-wide observability solutions covering metrics, logs, traces, synthetic monitoring, and real-user monitoring (RUM).

  • Configure infrastructure, application, database, middleware, network, and Kubernetes monitoring.

  • Create custom monitoring extensions and automation workflows using Dynatrace APIs.

  • Develop AI-driven monitoring use cases utilizing Dynatrace Davis AI for anomaly detection and root cause analysis.

ServiceNow Integration & Event Management

  • Design, implement, and support integration between Dynatrace and ServiceNow ITSM/Event Management platforms.

  • Configure automated incident creation, event correlation, deduplication, and alert enrichment.

  • Implement bidirectional synchronization between Dynatrace events and ServiceNow incidents.

  • Integrate monitoring events with CMDB, Service Mapping, and Event Management workflows.

  • Develop event handling standards, escalation workflows, suppression policies, and alert tuning strategies to reduce noise and improve operational efficiency.

Dashboard & Reporting Engineering

  • Design and develop executive, operational, and technical dashboards using Dynatrace Dashboards

  • Create business service health dashboards, application performance dashboards, SLA reporting dashboards, and infrastructure monitoring views.

  • Develop advanced visualizations for:

    • Service availability

    • Application performance trends

    • Capacity analytics

    • Event correlation

    • Incident management KPIs

    • Observability maturity reporting

  • Provide meaningful insights and recommendations through data visualization and reporting.

Automation & Integration

  • Develop automation scripts using Python, Shell, Perl, or PowerShell.

  • Automate monitoring onboarding, dashboard creation, alert configuration, and reporting activities.

  • Integrate Dynatrace with enterprise platforms including ServiceNow, Splunk, CyberArk, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud services.

  • Utilize REST APIs and Infrastructure as Code practices for monitoring automation.

Operational Support & Governance

  • Monitor platform performance, capacity, availability, and data ingestion health.

  • Troubleshoot monitoring gaps, agent issues, integration failures, and dashboard performance concerns.

  • Define monitoring standards, governance policies, and operational best practices.

  • Create and maintain architecture documentation, SOPs, technical runbooks, and knowledge articles.

  • Support audit and compliance requirements by maintaining monitoring evidence and reporting controls.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Overall 8+ years of IT experience.

  • Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in Dynatrace administration and observability engineering.

  • Minimum 3+ years of experience integrating monitoring platforms with ServiceNow ITSM/Event Management.

  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale monitoring environments across infrastructure and application landscapes.

  • Experience in SaaS-based observability platforms and cloud monitoring solutions.

  • Strong experience working with Linux/RHEL environments.

  • Demonstrates advanced troubleshooting skills, analytical approach, and expertise in root-cause analysis within complex distributed environments.

  • Experience operating within regulated industries, preferably banking or financial services.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Dynatrace Associate, Professional, or Certified Administrator certification.

  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).

  • Experience with Observability, AIOps, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices.

  • Knowledge of AWS, Azure, and Hybrid Cloud monitoring.

  • Experience working within regulated financial services environments.

Red Nucleus is hiring a Agile Project Manager - iTakeControl to join our global team. This role will be fully onsite at our Pune office. There may be flexibility to transition to a hybrid work model in the future, based on business requirements.


Our purpose is advancing knowledge to improve lives. We succeed by being the premier provider of strategic learning and development, scientific advisory services, and medical communications solutions for the life sciences industry. Our global team is composed of nearly 800 full-time employees whose commitment to creativity, quality, and on-time delivery is unrivaled in our space.


At Red Nucleus, we believe in providing a rich working environment that pushes us to innovate in ways that engages our employees to be their best selves. Our culture is about meaningful work, a true sense of community, and fun. We love to celebrate our people and we are proud to have been Internationally recognized as a Great Place to Work".


How You Will Contribute

In this position, you will be working with our Clinical Research team. For more information, please visit ITC I Red Nucleus.

Job Overview

iTakeControl is a clinical trial platform supporting live studies within a validated, GxP-compliant environment. We are bringing the platform fully in-house and building the team that will own and grow it.


We are looking for an experienced Agile Project Manager to own delivery and be the bridge between the business and the engineering team. You will balance two priorities: coordinating the delivery of the platform to clients including configuring and launching new clinical studies and driving the ongoing development of the product. The immediate focus is keeping client delivery running smoothly; as that settles into a steady cadence, the role grows to take on more of the process governance-Agile principles, Scrum practices, and continuous improvement.


This is a delivery-accountable role for someone who can translate between business and technical teams, keep priorities clear, and make sure the right work ships at the right time. It works closely with US-based stakeholders and requires daily overlap with US hours.

What Youll Own

  • Client delivery own the end-to-end delivery and configuration of the platform for clients, getting new studies live and supported on time and within compliance
  • Product delivery own the teams delivery rhythm: prioritization, planning, and release coordination for the core platform in collaboration with the Product management team
  • The bridge intake the feature requirements, enhancement requests from product team and create the realistic development plan in collaboration with the engineering team, and keep both sides aligned on what comes first and why
  • Priority calls make and communicate the trade-offs when client delivery and product work compete for the same people
  • Delivery health track and report progress using meaningful flow metrics, and surface risks early with options
  • Process efficiency - As the engineering team matures, build efficiency KPIs for teams delivery and quality performance.

You will partner closely with the Technical Lead, who owns technical direction; this role owns coordination and delivery.


What Were Looking For

Experience and Mindset

  • 7+ years managing software delivery, with a strong track record of shipping on time
  • Proven experience owning client-facing delivery or implementation not only internal product work
  • Strong agile background, with the judgement to choose and adapt the right approach for the team rather than applying one framework by rote (we are not tied to a single methodology)
  • Comfortable managing multiple concurrent priorities and competing deadlines
  • A natural translator between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders, who can negotiate realistic plans between the two
  • Strong ownership instincts accountable for outcomes, not just facilitation
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills builds trust quickly across clients, leadership, and the engineering team, and keeps everyone informed and aligned
  • Stays composed under pressure keeps a clear head and a steady hand when priorities collide, deadlines tighten, or issues escalate, and brings the team along calmly
  • Clear, honest communicator who brings problems forward early

Clinical and Regulatory

  • Life sciences background is essential experience delivering software in clinical trials, healthcare IT, pharma, medical devices, or an equivalent regulated environment

  • Enough technical fluency to coordinate engineering work credibly understand dependencies, ask the right questions, and challenge estimates (you do not need to write code)
  • Comfortable with standard delivery and collaboration tooling, and open to AI-assisted tools that speed up planning and reporting

Education and Experience

  • 7+ years in software project / delivery management, including client-facing delivery and/or Scrum Master roles
  • 3+ years leading delivery for an engineering team

  • Agile and/or project management certification (CSM, PSM, PMI-ACP, SAFe, PMP, or equivalent) a plus

jobDescription:
Job Opening for Senior Data Scientist

Reports to: Head of Data Science - Consulting

Team: Custom Consulting-Data Science

Level: Senior Consultant


Role Purpose

We are looking for Senior Data scientist to lead the technical automation edge of our Data Science team's work. This role is for someone as comfortable writing SQL/Python and building AI-driven workflows as they are interpreting consulting data someone who can turn repeatable research, data modelling tasks into reliable, scaled-up processes. The Data Science team works horizontally across GlobalData's consulting verticals Consumer, Food & Beverage, Packaging, Retail, Automotive, Agriculture and others — so automation built here is reused across bespoke, client-specific consulting engagements rather than one fixed sector. The team is actively building out a Projects & Skills-based automation pipeline (using tools like Claude) spanning proposal drafting, research instrument design, data consolidation, assisted modelling and report generation. A key focus area is automating secondary desk research — extracting insights from industry reports, online SKU analysis, company financial statements, and consumer survey creation/analysis.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build automation for the consulting workflow — SKU/store audits, secondary research consolidation, survey data processing, report and deck generation — using Python, SQL and AI-assisted tooling.
  • Build automation to extract and structure insights from secondary sources — industry reports, online SKU/pricing audits, and annual/quarterly company financial statements — to speed up model inputs across engagements.
  • Develop AI based tools to support consumer survey creation and scripting logic, and to automate first-pass analysis of survey outputs.
  • Extend the team's existing Claude-based automation initiative: build and maintain reusable Skills (repeatable SOPs) and Project knowledge bases across proposal, research, modelling and delivery stages.
  • Build and maintain SQL/Python pipelines that clean, validate and consolidate structured/unstructured research inputs ahead of modelling — reducing manual analyst effort.
  • Support market sizing, forecasting work with a strong analytics lens, including exploring transparent/interpretable forecasting approaches (e.g. driver-based or hierarchical models) as an alternative to black-box outputs.
  • Partner with consultants across verticals — Consumer, Food & Beverage, Packaging, Retail and others — on custom consulting solutions, bringing automation and analytics into bespoke, client-specific frameworks rather than standard reporting.
  • Manage and coach junior consultants and analysts on automation- and analytics-heavy workstreams.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 4-5+ years combining hands-on Python and SQL work with consulting, market research or commercial analytics — this is not a pure engineering role, and consulting/analytics fluency is essential.
  • Strong, demonstrable Python skills for data processing, automation and dashboarding; solid SQL for querying and structuring data.
  • Ability to build and deploy streamlit /flask applications and dashboards
  • Practical experience building or driving automation using AI/LLM tools (prompt-based workflows, agentic tools, or similar) — able to design a repeatable process
  • Prior hands-on experience with statistical modelling, timeseries forecasting
  • Strong Excel skills (lookups, pivot tables, structured spreadsheet design) for data analysis, and building or working within a data model.
  • Experience automating extraction of insights from unstructured or semi-structured secondary sources — industry reports, company financial statements/filings
  • Solid grounding in data analytics and quantitative reasoning; able to sanity-check forecasts and automation outputs against consulting judgement.
  • Strong communication skills and demonstrated ability to manage or mentor junior data scientists /analysts.
  • Preferred: prior experience in market research/strategy consulting and/or market sizing/forecasting modelling.

Good to Have

  • Experience with statistical/forecasting techniques (regression-based driver models, Bayesian or hierarchical modelling) for transparent, auditable forecasts.
  • Familiarity with building custom tools/dashboards (e.g. Power BI, Excel-based tools, lightweight web apps) for internal or client use.
  • Exposure to consulting deliverable types — market sizing decks, SKU audits, competitive benchmarking — in Consumer, Retail, Foodservice, Packaging, Automotive or Agriculture sectors.

Thanks & Regards

Salim

MetLife is seeking a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to ensure the reliability, availability, and performance of critical applications and platforms.
The SRE Engineer will monitor production systems, respond to incidents, improve observability, maintain runbooks, and automate operational tasks.   • Observability Support: Create and maintain dashboards, log queries, telemetry checks, alert validation, and actionable monitoring signals.
  • Runbook Management: Document operational procedures, update recovery steps, validate readiness with service owners, and support knowledge sharing.
  • Automation: Create scripts for repetitive checks, data collection, remediation, operational reporting, and toil reduction.

  • SRE Alignment: Support adoption of SLOs, SLIs, SLAs, error budgets, operational readiness reviews, and production support standards.

  • Collaboration: Work with engineering, infrastructure, cloud, and application teams to align service performance with business goals.


Skills and Experience
  • Foundations: Linux, networking fundamentals, application support, cloud fundamentals, production operations, and ITIL-style incident/change processes.
  • Scripting: Python, PowerShell, Bash, or equivalent scripting for automation, diagnostics, evidence collection, and reporting.
  • Tools: Git, CI/CD basics, ServiceNow or equivalent ticketing; exposure to Elastic/ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, APM, and Azure Monitor preferred.
  • Cloud Containers: Azure services, Docker, Kubernetes, and hybrid cloud operations exposure; Terraform or infrastructure-as-code awareness preferred.
  • Reliability: Basic understanding of SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, error budgets, alerting, incident response, postmortems, and operational runbooks.

  • Database: Hands-on SQL skills for operational diagnostics, data validation, and service health checks.
  • Execution: Disciplined follow-through, evidence capture, documentation, escalation hygiene, and collaboration during incidents.
  • Learning Mindset: Willingness to deepen skills in cloud, Kubernetes, observability, automation, resilience engineering, and secure operations.


Minimum Qualifications
  • 2+ years in production support, DevOps, infrastructure, cloud operations, or software engineering.
  • Experience supporting business-critical systems and working in incident, problem, and change management processes.
  • Ability to script and automate standard operational tasks using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or equivalent.
  • Bachelor s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Exposure to regulated enterprise, insurance, banking, or financial services environments preferred.
  • Business proficiency in English; Japanese language skills are a plus.


Preferred Exposure
  • Hybrid cloud platforms including on-premises and Azure-hosted services.
  • Observability platforms such as ELK/Elastic, Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, Azure Monitor, and Azure Application Insights.
  • GitHub, Azure DevOps, pipelines, repositories, and operational change controls.

  • SRE practices including operational readiness reviews, service health reviews, and toil reduction initiatives.

This role has been designed as Hybrid with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Join us as we develop innovative solutions that revolutionize how we help customers by simplifying their operations and move the world forward.
Who We Are
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today s complex world. Job Description
HPE s acquisition of Juniper Networks is one of the most significant moves in the company s history, bringing two networking leaders together to build HPE Networking , with the ambition of creating the best networking business on the planet . This role sits at the center of that effort as part of the Lead-to-Cash (L2C) program , responsible for unifying quoting, ordering, and fulfillment across the combined HPE and Juniper networking portfolios onto a single platform , replacing fragmented legacy systems with one seamless, scalable experience for sellers, partners, and customers worldwide.
As part of a fast-moving, multi-year transformation , the team will stabilize near-term operations, migrate core platforms, onboard businesses and suppliers globally , and build new capabilities from the ground up. The choices made here will shape how the combined networking business operates for years to come. You will work closely with business leaders, IT architects, suppliers, and partner stakeholders on a program with direct executive visibility, solving integration challenges at a scale few companies ever attempt.
For the right person, this is a rare opportunity to help build a new business unit from its earliest days , rather than inherit someone else s systems. You will gain hands-on exposure to enterprise-scale platform integration and cross-functional program leadership , with the kind of complexity and pace that can accelerate your career. If you want your work to have a visible impact on a company making a significant investment in its future, this is where that happens.
Workstream-Specific Details
What you ll do:
Responsibilities
  • The Supplier Onboarding - Supply Chain Functional Analyst is responsible for delivering comprehensive SAP S/4HANA solutions across sales, materials management, and logistics execution functions. This role requires deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA, combined with hands-on experience in full lifecycle implementations and system integration. The candidate will drive order-to-cash optimization, logistics execution excellence, and supply chain automation while leveraging advanced tools and intelligent systems to enhance process efficiency and data quality. This role is critical to HPEs supply chain transformation and operational excellence initiatives.
  • Lead functional design and implementation of SAP S/4HANA - SD, MM, and LE modules, ensuring alignment with business requirements and best practices.
  • Analyze complex business requirements and develop conceptual and detailed designs for order fulfillment, logistics execution, and supply chain processes.
  • Configure SAP S/4HANA systems for sales order processing, delivery management, shipping, picking, packing, goods issue, and route determination.
  • Support the design and optimization of logistics execution workflows including outbound delivery, stock transport orders (STO), and shipment processing.
  • Manage order-to-cash process implementation covering order booking, sourcing, order scheduling, buy-sell processes, and fulfillment.
  • Design and document product structures, bill of materials (BOM), and production models including build-to-stock, configure-to-order, and make-to-order scenarios.
  • Lead system integration efforts including interface design and configuration with both SAP and non-SAP systems using iDocs, RFCs, BAPIs, and APIs.
  • Write detailed technical specifications for ABAP custom program development and coordinate with development teams on implementation and testing.
  • Perform comprehensive testing activities including functional testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Support the implementation of intelligent process automation solutions for routine supply chain and logistics tasks.
  • Troubleshoot complex configuration issues, system integration problems, and process discrepancies across SAP and integrated systems.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive documentation including process flows, configuration guides, technical specifications, and user procedures.
  • Identify areas for process improvement and system optimization, leveraging data analytics and process insights.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, IT teams, development teams, and cross-functional groups to ensure successful solution delivery.
  • Work effectively in distributed, multi-geography team environments and mentor junior functional resources.
What you need to bring:
Education And Experience Required
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science/Information Technology, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or related field.
  • Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in SAP S/4HANA SD, MM, and LE modules with deep functional expertise.
  • Minimum 1 full lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementation project (design, configuration, testing, go-live, and post-implementation support).
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in high-tech manufacturing or technology industry environments.
  • Extensive experience in logistics execution including delivery processing, picking, packing, goods issue, printing, shipping communications, scheduling, outbound delivery, STO, shipment processing, and route determination.
  • Project experience designing and implementing interfaces with both SAP and non-SAP systems using iDocs, RFCs, and BAPIs.
  • Ability to read and understand ABAP code with debugging skills (preferred).
  • Experience with automation technologies, RPA platforms, or intelligent business process tools (preferred).
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements using AI-generated insights, process mining analytics, and agentic recommendations.
  • Previous experience with SAP ECC and knowledge of SAP ECC to S/4HANA migration concepts (preferred).
Knowledge And Skills
  • Expert-level proficiency in SAP S/4HANA across SD, MM, and LE modules, including configuration, customization, and optimization of order fulfillment and logistics execution processes.
  • Deep expertise in order-to-cash processes covering order booking, sourcing, order scheduling, buy-sell scenarios, and fulfillment, combined with strong understanding of product structures, BOM, and production models (build-to-stock, configure-to-order, make-to-order).
  • Advanced knowledge of logistics execution including delivery processing, picking, packing, goods issue, shipping communications, outbound delivery, STO, shipment processing, and route determination.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP system integration, interface design, and configuration using iDocs, RFCs, BAPIs, and APIs for both SAP and non-SAP systems.
  • Ability to analyze complex business requirements, develop conceptual and detailed designs, perform SAP S/4HANA configurations, and write technical specifications for ABAP custom program development.
  • Working knowledge of intelligent process automation (RPA/IPA) platforms and agentic AI frameworks for supply chain and logistics automation, combined with understanding of autonomous systems governance and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Proficiency in comprehensive testing methodologies including functional, integration, and UAT testing with ability to identify and resolve configuration and integration issues.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with ability to read ABAP code, debug issues, and troubleshoot complex system problems across multiple integrated modules.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and documentation skills with ability to articulate complex technical and functional concepts to diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in distributed, multi-geography team environments, mentor junior resources, and drive process improvement initiatives through data-driven insights and collaborative feedback.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with ability to troubleshoot AATP configuration issues, integration problems, and planning discrepancies.

the end-to-end execution of Off-deck (whatsapp, Push, SMS, Emailer) and On-deck (banners, icons,

Growth, and Traffic teams to ensure campaigns are set up accurately, approved on time, and
monitored for performance.

Campaign Execution Management

Nodedupe, Event-based), Email, SMS, Chat, and WhatsApp channels.

segmentation, and multi-step flows.

Display).
Data Fetching Validation

reference against push campaign base size checks.

specs before campaign scheduling.

delivery rates (expected benchmark: 50-60% delivery/acquiry).

Sheet to ensure alignment.

and CategoryName key-value pairs are correctly mapped (case-sensitive).
Quality Control Scheduling

- Conduct banner QC in line with Banner SOP guidelines, verifying image specs, deeplinks, and
widget types.
- Test campaigns during permitted testing hours (7:00 AM-10:00 PM) using the designated test
webhook.

Required Skills Qualifications
CleverTap Expertise (Mandatory)
- Hands-on experience with CleverTap for campaign creation, audience segmentation, and
channel configuration.
- Proficient in setting up Events and Journeys in CleverTap, including multi-step flows, event
triggers, and user property filters.
- Understanding of CleverTap concepts: Native Display, Push campaigns, cascade mode, sub-
contexts, frequency capping, and DND settings.
- Familiarity with webhook configuration (live and test) for Push, Email, SMS, WhatsApp, and
Chat channels.
- Hands-on with AI usage to execute more campaigns in shorter duration.
- Basic understanding of other communication tools like Meta/WhatsApp, ConnectPlus (Tokom).
Data Fetching Analytical Skills
- Ability to fetch, validate, and cross-reference campaign data from multiple trackers and sheets
(Google Sheets / Excel).
- Basic understanding of segmentation logic: user properties, behavioral filters, segment
exclusions, and frequency rules.
- Ability to identify and flag data discrepancies or campaign mismatches quickly and accurately.
Operational Process Skills
- Strong attention to detail - ability to follow multi-step SOPs precisely and maintain zero-miss
campaign execution and ability to manage repetitive operational tasks.
- Experience raising and tracking tickets on Jira or similar tools
- Good time management skills to handle approval deadlines, testing windows, and scheduling
timelines simultaneously.
- Proactive, organised and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
